item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! Let's get started. It's the weekend. No school today! Here is your weather report for Saturday, November 21. It's Saturday, a whole day to do what you like. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be sunny from start to finish. It will reach 14 degrees, and drop down to 3 degrees. A bit parky today, as they say. Rain is very unlikely today. The sun goes down at 4:53 this evening, about 1 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? Wrap up warm today, with a big coat and cosy gloves! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be under a blanket of cloud, with a high of 15 degrees. Here's a question: what is the kindest thing you can do today? And that's the weather. Have a brilliant day!
